title: Compass and Ledger
author: Beatrix Ravensworth
blurb: Ulyana Eriksen, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
